requirements: R1: Patch the internal task status synchronization logic so that internal 'done' tasks are accurately reconciled with non-merged GitHub PR states

slices.title: Patch internal task status synchronization with GitHub PR state
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization patch for this epic, I want to accurately reconcile the internal task status with the GitHub PR state without introducing new data models or contracts, so that the flow core can resume processing active work accurately
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task marked as 'done' internally
When the corresponding GitHub PR is closed but not merged
Then the internal task status is updated to reflect the actual PR state, and synchronization telemetry is emitted
slices.tocConstraintRef: GitHub PR and internal status reconciliation mismatch
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce the percentage of tasks falsely marked as done with closed but unmerged PRs from current to 0%
